propositions: Copilot CLI silently drops skills with invalid frontmatter, including three rebar skills that exceed the 1024-character description limit or contain unparseable YAML syntax.
The rebar-implement and rebar-janitor skills have descriptions exceeding 1024 characters; rebar-debug contains an unquoted colon that breaks YAML plain-scalar parsing.
A new lint script (check_skill_frontmatter.py) validates SKILL.md frontmatter structure, description length, and name format against the Agent Skills spec.
The lint check is integrated into the make lint target to catch frontmatter violations at CI/commit time rather than silently at skill-load time.

Rewriting skill descriptions as YAML folded block scalars (description: >-) neutralizes parsing breaks and enables trimming descriptions to the 1024-character cap while preserving invocation triggers.
